title: Issue Routing Classification
purpose: Candidate primitive contract for classifying ordinary issue intake into routing concepts. It encodes confirmed bug-fix and feature-request meanings while leaving mutual-exclusivity and conflict-representation policy unresolved for later acceptance review.

normative_requirements.text: The routing classification vocabulary shall include `bug-fix` for reported behavior believed to violate already accepted authority and `feature-request` for requested new or changed direction.
The `bug-fix` and `feature-request` classifications may be assigned at issue creation or after review.
A routing classification shall remain distinct from `governed-work` governance state.
Classification uncertainty that changes the applicable authority path shall be surfaced rather than silently converted into repository mutation authority.
This candidate does not define whether `bug-fix` and `feature-request` are mutually exclusive, whether additional routing classifications exist, or the representation of classification conflicts.
